item.title: Hartmann North America has grown into one of Brantford's largest employers
item.description: Established in 1917, Hartmann North America came to Brantford in 2002 and is now the largest producer of moulded-fibre egg cartons in the world.

item.title: Brantford Police Service Chief’s Advisory Committee concludes term
item.description: The Brantford Police Service Chief’s Advisory Committee has officially concluded its 2025 term, providing insight and guidance on key priorities, including new cruiser and uniform design and feedback on the 2026 budget. item.title: Call for artists announced for 2026 Grand River Arts Festival in Brantford
item.description: The Grand River Arts Festival is taking place Sept. 18 and 19 on the historic grounds of Glenhyrst Art Gallery of Brant.

item.title: Michaud, Pereira eighth at Olympics
item.description: Brant Figure Skating Club member Trennt Michaud and partner Lia Pereira finished eighth in the pairs event at the 2026 Winter Olympic Games in Italy. Michaud and Pereira were making their Olympic debut after capturing the Canadian national championship in January. item.title: Brantford Bulldogs 3-for-3 on weekend, increase lead atop OHL standings
Program helps people on their journey through grief
item.description: The death of his father in 2019 and a traumatic car accident in 2024 that left his wife seriously injured, led Douglas Fearon to seek a grief recovery course in the Brantford area.
